tools.name: comparegraph_absent_check
tools.description: Is a feature absent from a clone's graph? Searches the feature's terms over symbols, paths, community labels/keywords and node kinds of the latest run; `absent` is true only when every channel has zero hits, and `reason` says why (`hits`, `family words set aside: <words>`, or `absent`). It also returns `read_set`, the top 10 ranked candidates (with `total`, `score` and `why`) that a `none` must read; pass `searched` (the terms you would record) to include the hits of that search. Reads only: it records nothing, and no MCP tool can record a graph-backed absence (that is `comparegraph claim ... none` on the CLI).

searched.description: optional: the terms a none would be recorded with; their search hits join the read_set and make absent false when found

include_non_code.description: also rank css/scss/html parser nodes in read_set (default false; a none is judged without them)

tools.name: comparegraph_check
tools.description: Verify the store: schema, search index, citation locations, the action log. Reads only: it never writes a flag; a clone that is missing or at another head than its run read is reported clone_unavailable and its locations are not read. Returns a compact envelope listing problems, if any.

tools.name: comparegraph_claim
tools.description: WRITE: record a claim (has|partial|none|unknown) about a feature in a clone. author is required; has/partial need at least one citation in `at` (path:start-end) that resolves now; none needs `searched` terms that name the feature and find nothing, or find hits that you list in `read_hits` after reading each.

family.description: disambiguates a feature id that exists in several families

at.description: citations, path:start-end or path:line, relative to the clone

searched.description: terms the absence was checked with (none)

read_hits.description: the qualified names of the `read_set.candidates` that `comparegraph_absent_check` (with the same `searched`) returns, after you opened each; the top 10 ranked candidates, not every hit

tools.name: comparegraph_claims
tools.description: Latest claim per (clone, feature) with its citations; history=true lists every row with its supersede chain.

tools.name: comparegraph_communities
tools.description: Module clusters of a repo's latest run (label, keywords, cohesion, size). Returns a compact, paged envelope.

cursor.description: opaque cursor from a previous page

tools.name: comparegraph_dead_code
tools.description: Dead-code CANDIDATES (confidence unknown: dynamic dispatch is invisible). Paged.

tools.name: comparegraph_doctor
tools.description: Report the store and every provider. Returns a compact envelope.

tools.name: comparegraph_entry_points
tools.description: Symbols nothing calls that are exported, handler-named or main. Paged.

tools.name: comparegraph_families
tools.description: Registered taxonomy families with feature counts. Returns a compact envelope.

tools.name: comparegraph_governance_verify
tools.description: Re-walk the action log beside the store (every write of backup, restore-store, gc, archive, restore, check --mark): each hash, a gapless seq, the head kept in the store, and each archive flag against its manifest. Fails (check_failed) naming the first broken line. Reads only.

tools.name: comparegraph_impact
tools.description: Blast radius: everything that transitively depends on a symbol or on file(s), summary first (total, by_hop, by_kind) then items paged by limit/cursor (best path_confidence first, each with hop and community), plus the tests that reach it.

tools.name: comparegraph_map
tools.description: Candidate symbols and communities per feature of a family in one clone. Candidates are never verdicts; writes nothing.

tools.name: comparegraph_matrix
tools.description: Active features of a family against every clone: verdicts, prevalence, gaps and differentiators. A clone whose relatedness shows `not run` has no stored band; relate=true scores those first (writes bands).

relate.description: score comparators with no stored relatedness band before building the matrix, default false

reach.description: only the rows with a cell whose latest claim has this reach

tools.name: comparegraph_relate
tools.description: Latest stored relatedness band per (clone, family). Reads only: it does not compute; run `comparegraph relate` to refresh.

tools.name: comparegraph_relevance
tools.description: Per repo: factor counts (live has/partial claims, pull rows, days since cited, best band, UI reference, size) and, with a relevance-policy/1 file, a score and a class (ROOT, KEEP-PRIMARY, KEEP, KEEP-NEW, ARCHIVE, REMOVE-CANDIDATE; `unrated` without a policy). Weights live only in the policy. Reads only; paged; explain gives one repo with every term.

policy.description: path of a relevance-policy/1 file (default .comparegraph/policy.json when present)

family.description: restrict every factor to one family

explain.description: one repo with every term of its score

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD ages are counted to (default: newest timestamp in the store)

tools.name: comparegraph_repos
tools.description: List registered repos (name, licence, lane, role, head) with the latest run summary (status, nodes, communities, store_hash). Archived repos are left out unless archived or all is true; no_port lists only the repos whose code must not be ported, with why. Returns a compact, paged envelope.

no_port.description: only the repos whose code must not be ported: lane not take, a never-copy licence (AGPL, GPL, LGPL, SSPL, BUSL, fair-code ...) or no licence read; each row says why

cursor.description: opaque cursor from a previous page

tools.name: comparegraph_search
tools.description: Full-text search over symbols of each repo's latest run. Returns a compact, paged envelope of hits with licence-lane labels.

query.description: words to find in symbol names and paths

kind.description: node kind, e.g. function, class, file

cursor.description: opaque cursor from a previous page

tools.name: comparegraph_show
tools.description: One symbol with callers, callees, community and licence lane. Compact by default; detail=full adds its current source lines.

max_callers.description: cap on callers and callees listed, default 50; a truncated list is reported in limitations

tools.name: comparegraph_tests_for
tools.description: Tests linked to a symbol directly or through at most 3 call hops.

tools.name: comparegraph_traverse
tools.description: Nodes reachable from a symbol over calls/extends/implements (kinds), with hop distance, path_confidence and the path to each. Summary first (total, by_hop, by_kind), then items paged by limit/cursor, best path_confidence first. Bounded: depth<=10, max_nodes<=2000; truncation is recorded in evidence.limitations.

tools.name: comparegraph_ui_verify
tools.description: UI evidence: the determinism gate. FAILS (check_failed) on any difference, a partial comparison, a key on one side only, an unstable capture, inputs that differ (unless allow_input_drift) or, with integrity, a changed file. For every capture key present in both runs, domHash and metrics must be equal, the image dHash within 4 bits and net.failed equal; every difference is reported (check_failed with the list in data when any). Give run_a and run_b (two runs of one root; refused when they share evidence files) or root_a and root_b (two ui roots holding one run each, matched without the version).

integrity.description: also re-hash every evidence file and image blob of both runs against the digests the probe recorded
